findings.observation: 131 words across 59.243 seconds; longest detected silence 0.47 seconds.
findings.implication: Long silence is not demonstrated as the cause of perceived sluggishness; silence and WPM do not measure prosody.
findings.next_test: Same 15–20-second passage; compare baseline with shorter natural clauses and reviewed punctuation, at the same overall playback speed.

findings.observation: Current Voicebox path is reference-conditioned Qwen3-TTS 0.6B Base on MLX; delivery instructions are explicitly rejected. Warm B adds 180 Hz, cuts 1100 Hz and uses mild compression.
findings.implication: A more emotional prompt is not currently supported; EQ changes timbre rather than language delivery.
findings.next_test: Compare raw and warm B at matched loudness using existing references. Review Amazon, Jeff Bezos, S3 and spoken dates with a display-text/spoken-text lexicon; listen before declaring a defect.

findings.observation: Final integrated loudness -19.1 LUFS, true peak -4.5 dBTP; no clipping detected.
findings.implication: There is headroom for a louder final mix; this is not proof of a platform delivery violation.
findings.next_test: Compare a separate final mix near -16 to -17 LUFS with a true-peak ceiling of -1 dBTP on phone speakers. Preserve the global Voicebox defaults.

findings.observation: Only 16 seconds use moving source video; two source videos are views of the same warehouse. Opening and closing reuse the warehouse photograph.
findings.implication: Limited variety and weak visual evidence for the historical/company-transformation story.
findings.next_test: Broaden reviewed footage coverage before increasing render complexity; match each shot to the specific spoken idea and retain author/year/source records.

findings.observation: Opening card lasts 6 seconds; cloud reveal starts at 32 seconds and its diagram holds for 13 seconds.
findings.implication: The books-to-cloud contrast arrives late; original graphics mostly finish animating early in the scene.
findings.next_test: Put the transformation in the first 2–3 seconds, then test meaningful shot changes and progressive diagram reveals; 2–4-second shots are an editorial experiment, not a mandatory cadence.

findings.observation: All seven scenes repeat headline/media/caption/footer layout; footage is restricted to an 800px-high window in a 1920px frame. Source audio is muted, with no music or sound design.
findings.implication: Consistent cards aid reading but reduce immersion and variation.
findings.next_test: Use full-frame footage for selected beats, reduce simultaneous repeated text, add restrained licensed sound only after voice intelligibility is verified.

findings.observation: 25 phrase-level cues; transcript parser discards full-JSON tokens. Caption spelling was manually corrected against script and exact audio hash.
findings.implication: Phrase starts are usable for scenes; word-level highlighting and automatic pronunciation QA are not validated.
findings.next_test: Expose and assess existing whisper.cpp token timing first, then compare a language-appropriate forced aligner only if word drift remains. Keep ASR errors separate from audible TTS errors.

findings.observation: Native OpenReel project contains a single flattened final MP4. Source scenes and graphics remain editable in Remotion.
findings.implication: The current pilot does not yet validate native per-shot manual corrections feeding back into an automated edit.
findings.next_test: Map source media IDs, clip in/out ranges, narration and caption layers into a separate native OpenReel project and verify one manual correction round trip.
